newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Strong winds in Brazil kill 3, hundreds homeless.
newsitem.headline: Strong winds in Brazil kill 3, hundreds homeless.

text.p: Three people died and 76 were injured when strong winds lashed southern Brazil, bringing down several buildings and leaving hundreds of families homeless, an official said on Saturday.
"There were very strong winds followed by torrential rain and hail," said Luis Antonio Borges Vieira, head of emergency rescue in Parana state.
The three deaths occurred in Nova Larangeiras, in an agricultural region, where more than half the town's buildings and homes were damaged by Friday's storm, Vieira said.

About 600 people in the town were sheltering in a municipal sports hall after their homes were ripped apart. Thirty-one people remained in hospital and rescue workers were sifting through the wreckage of several collapsed buildings in the search for possible further victims, he said.
"The only thing you could see was destruction, houses flying and walls falling," a local man Nelio Veronese told national Globo television.
